---
title: "Module 08: Spatial cluster differential expression analysis"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-11"
---

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 08 — Spatial Seurat cluster differential expression analysis
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Perform differential expression analysis between Harmony-derived spatial
#   Seurat clusters generated in Module 07. Identify cluster-enriched and
#   cluster-depleted genes, apply predefined statistical thresholds, export
#   complete and significant marker tables, summarize differential expression
#   results, select top positive markers, generate a cluster-marker heatmap,
#   produce professional volcano plots for every spatial cluster, visualize
#   Prkcd expression across the integrated spatial dataset, validate all
#   outputs, and preserve the integrated Seurat object for downstream
#   inferCNV analysis.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds
#
# Primary analysis outputs:
#   results/spatial/cluster_dea/
#
# Output figures:
#   figures/spatial/cluster_dea/
#   figures/spatial/cluster_dea/volcano_plots/
#
# Differential expression settings:
#   Assay:                       SCT
#   Identity:                    spatial_cluster
#   Test:                        Wilcoxon rank-sum test
#   Minimum detection fraction: 0.10
#   FindAllMarkers log2FC:       0.25
#
# Significant DEG definition:
#   adjusted P < 0.05
#   |average log2FC| > 0.58
#
# Notes:
#   - Each cluster is compared against all remaining spatial spots.
#   - The 0.58 log2FC reporting threshold corresponds approximately to
#     a 1.5-fold expression difference.
#   - Differential expression is performed on the SCT assay.
#   - The raw Spatial assay is not modified.
#   - Malignant versus non-malignant differential expression is performed
#     later after inferCNV-based classification.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load required packages
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
  library(here)
})


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reproducibility settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1234)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

dea_assay <- "SCT"

cluster_column <- "spatial_cluster"

marker_test <- "wilcox"

marker_min_pct <- 0.10

marker_test_log2fc_threshold <- 0.25

significant_log2fc_threshold <- 0.58

adjusted_p_threshold <- 0.05

top_markers_per_cluster <- 10

volcano_labels_per_cluster <- 10

gene_of_interest <- "Prkcd"


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define repository paths
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "cluster_dea"
)

cluster_table_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "cluster_dea",
  "cluster_tables"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "cluster_dea"
)

volcano_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "cluster_dea",
  "volcano_plots"
)

directories_to_create <- c(
  results_directory,
  cluster_table_directory,
  figure_directory,
  volcano_directory
)

for (directory in directories_to_create) {
  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}

input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds"
)

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 08 — Spatial cluster differential expression analysis\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Repository root:    ", here::here(), "\n",
  "Input object:       ", input_file, "\n",
  "Results directory: ", results_directory, "\n",
  "Figure directory:  ", figure_directory, "\n",
  "Volcano directory: ", volcano_directory, "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Validate and load Module 07 output
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop(
    "Module 07 output was not found:\n",
    input_file,
    "\n\nRun 07_spatial_normalization_clustering.Rmd before Module 08."
  )
}

cat(
  "Loading integrated spatial Seurat object...\n"
)

spatial_object <- readRDS(
  input_file
)

if (!inherits(spatial_object, "Seurat")) {
  stop(
    "Loaded input file is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}

available_assays <- names(
  spatial_object@assays
)

if (!dea_assay %in% available_assays) {
  stop(
    "Required DEA assay was not found: ",
    dea_assay,
    "\nAvailable assays: ",
    paste(
      available_assays,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

if (!cluster_column %in% colnames(spatial_object@meta.data)) {
  stop(
    "Required spatial cluster metadata column was not found: ",
    cluster_column
  )
}

cat(
  "Object loaded successfully:\n",
  "  Features: ", nrow(spatial_object), "\n",
  "  Spots:    ", ncol(spatial_object), "\n",
  "  Samples:  ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_object$sample
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "  Clusters: ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_object@meta.data[[cluster_column]]
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Set SCT assay and spatial cluster identities
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  spatial_object
) <- dea_assay

Seurat::Idents(
  spatial_object
) <- cluster_column

cluster_ids <- levels(
  Seurat::Idents(
    spatial_object
  )
)

if (length(cluster_ids) < 2) {
  stop(
    "At least two spatial clusters are required for differential expression."
  )
}

cat(
  "\nSpatial cluster identities:\n"
)

print(
  cluster_ids
)

cat(
  "\nSpots per spatial cluster:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    Seurat::Idents(
      spatial_object
    )
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Inspect SCT assay before differential expression
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Inspecting SCT assay before differential expression\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

sct_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_object[[dea_assay]]
)

cat(
  "SCT assay layers:\n"
)

print(
  sct_layers
)

if (sum(grepl("^data", sct_layers)) > 1) {
  cat(
    "\nMultiple SCT data layers detected.\n",
    "Joining SCT layers before differential expression...\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  spatial_object <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    spatial_object,
    assay = dea_assay
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Prepare SCT assay for marker analysis when required
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Preparing SCT assay for differential expression\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

sct_model_count <- 0

if ("SCTModel.list" %in% slotNames(spatial_object[[dea_assay]])) {
  sct_model_count <- length(
    spatial_object[[dea_assay]]@SCTModel.list
  )
}

cat(
  "SCT models detected: ",
  sct_model_count,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

if (sct_model_count > 1) {
  cat(
    "Multiple SCT models detected.\n",
    "Running PrepSCTFindMarkers() before DEA...\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  spatial_object <- Seurat::PrepSCTFindMarkers(
    object = spatial_object,
    assay = dea_assay,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
} else {
  cat(
    "Single SCT model detected; PrepSCTFindMarkers() is not required.\n"
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Record differential expression parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

dea_parameters <- data.frame(
  parameter = c(
    "assay",
    "cluster_identity",
    "test",
    "minimum_detection_fraction",
    "FindAllMarkers_log2FC_threshold",
    "significant_log2FC_threshold",
    "adjusted_P_threshold",
    "top_markers_per_cluster"
  ),
  value = c(
    dea_assay,
    cluster_column,
    marker_test,
    marker_min_pct,
    marker_test_log2fc_threshold,
    significant_log2fc_threshold,
    adjusted_p_threshold,
    top_markers_per_cluster
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

dea_parameter_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_cluster_DEA_parameters.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  dea_parameters,
  dea_parameter_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Run differential expression for all spatial clusters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "Running spatial cluster differential expression\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Assay:                       ", dea_assay, "\n",
  "Identity:                    ", cluster_column, "\n",
  "Test:                        ", marker_test, "\n",
  "Minimum detection fraction: ", marker_min_pct, "\n",
  "Testing log2FC threshold:    ",
  marker_test_log2fc_threshold,
  "\n",
  "Reporting log2FC threshold:  ",
  significant_log2fc_threshold,
  "\n",
  "Adjusted P threshold:        ",
  adjusted_p_threshold,
  "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)

cluster_markers <- Seurat::FindAllMarkers(
  object = spatial_object,
  assay = dea_assay,
  only.pos = FALSE,
  min.pct = marker_min_pct,
  logfc.threshold = marker_test_log2fc_threshold,
  test.use = marker_test,
  verbose = FALSE
)

if (nrow(cluster_markers) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No spatial cluster marker genes were identified."
  )
}

cat(
  "Differential expression completed successfully.\n",
  "Total marker results: ",
  nrow(cluster_markers),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Standardize gene column
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!"gene" %in% colnames(cluster_markers)) {
  cluster_markers$gene <- rownames(
    cluster_markers
  )
}

cluster_markers$gene <- as.character(
  cluster_markers$gene
)

cluster_markers <- cluster_markers[
  !is.na(cluster_markers$gene) &
  cluster_markers$gene != "",
]

if (anyDuplicated(colnames(cluster_markers)) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicated column names were detected in the marker table."
  )
}

cat(
  "Valid marker rows after gene-name cleanup: ",
  nrow(cluster_markers),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Classify significant differential-expression results
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_markers <- cluster_markers %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(p_val_adj) &
      p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold &
      avg_log2FC > significant_log2fc_threshold ~
        "Upregulated",

      !is.na(p_val_adj) &
      p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold &
      avg_log2FC < -significant_log2fc_threshold ~
        "Downregulated",

      TRUE ~
        "Not significant"
    )
  )

significant_cluster_markers <- cluster_markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significance != "Not significant"
  )

significant_positive_markers <- cluster_markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significance == "Upregulated"
  )

significant_negative_markers <- cluster_markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significance == "Downregulated"
  )

cat(
  "\nSignificant differential-expression results:\n",
  "  Total significant: ",
  nrow(significant_cluster_markers),
  "\n",
  "  Upregulated:       ",
  nrow(significant_positive_markers),
  "\n",
  "  Downregulated:     ",
  nrow(significant_negative_markers),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Save complete and significant marker tables
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

all_marker_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_cluster_markers_all.csv"
)

significant_marker_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_cluster_markers_significant.csv"
)

positive_marker_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_cluster_markers_upregulated.csv"
)

negative_marker_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_cluster_markers_downregulated.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  cluster_markers,
  all_marker_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  significant_cluster_markers,
  significant_marker_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  significant_positive_markers,
  positive_marker_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  significant_negative_markers,
  negative_marker_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Summarize marker results by cluster
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

marker_summary <- cluster_markers %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    cluster
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    tested_markers = dplyr::n(),
    significant_markers = sum(
      significance != "Not significant"
    ),
    upregulated_markers = sum(
      significance == "Upregulated"
    ),
    downregulated_markers = sum(
      significance == "Downregulated"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Spatial marker summary by cluster\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

print(
  marker_summary
)

marker_summary_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_cluster_marker_summary.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  marker_summary,
  marker_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Save cluster-specific significant DEG tables
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Saving cluster-specific DEG tables\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

cluster_table_files <- character(0)

for (cluster_id in cluster_ids) {
  cluster_results <- significant_cluster_markers %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.character(cluster) == cluster_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      p_val_adj,
      dplyr::desc(
        abs(avg_log2FC)
      )
    )

  cluster_table_file <- file.path(
    cluster_table_directory,
    paste0(
      "spatial_cluster_",
      cluster_id,
      "_significant_DEGs.csv"
    )
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    cluster_results,
    cluster_table_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  cluster_table_files <- c(
    cluster_table_files,
    cluster_table_file
  )
}

cat(
  "Cluster-specific DEG tables written: ",
  length(cluster_table_files),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Select top positive markers per cluster
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

top_positive_markers <- significant_positive_markers %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    cluster
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(
    order_by = avg_log2FC,
    n = top_markers_per_cluster,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

if (nrow(top_positive_markers) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No significant positive markers were available for heatmap generation."
  )
}

top_marker_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_cluster_top10_positive_markers.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  top_positive_markers,
  top_marker_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(
  "\nTop positive markers selected for ",
  length(
    unique(
      top_positive_markers$cluster
    )
  ),
  " clusters.\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 17. Prepare genes for marker heatmap
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

heatmap_genes <- unique(
  top_positive_markers$gene
)

heatmap_genes <- intersect(
  heatmap_genes,
  rownames(spatial_object)
)

if (length(heatmap_genes) == 0) {
  stop(
    "None of the selected heatmap genes were found in the spatial object."
  )
}

cat(
  "Genes included in marker heatmap: ",
  length(heatmap_genes),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 18. Scale selected marker genes for heatmap visualization
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_object <- Seurat::ScaleData(
  object = spatial_object,
  assay = dea_assay,
  features = heatmap_genes,
  verbose = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 19. Generate spatial cluster marker heatmap
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_heatmap <- Seurat::DoHeatmap(
  object = spatial_object,
  features = heatmap_genes,
  group.by = cluster_column,
  size = 3
) +
  Seurat::NoLegend()

print(
  cluster_heatmap
)

cluster_heatmap_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_cluster_top10_marker_heatmap.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = cluster_heatmap_file,
  plot = cluster_heatmap,
  width = 14,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 20. Generate volcano plots for every spatial cluster
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Generating spatial cluster volcano plots\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

volcano_files <- character(0)

volcano_plot_list <- list()

for (cluster_id in cluster_ids) {
  cluster_de <- cluster_markers %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.character(cluster) == cluster_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      plot_p = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(p_val_adj),
        NA_real_,
        pmax(
          p_val_adj,
          .Machine$double.xmin
        )
      ),
      neg_log10_p = -log10(
        plot_p
      )
    )

  volcano_labels <- cluster_de %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      significance == "Upregulated"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(
      order_by = avg_log2FC,
      n = volcano_labels_per_cluster,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )

  volcano_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    cluster_de,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = avg_log2FC,
      y = neg_log10_p
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(
        color = significance
      ),
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 1.6
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(
        -significant_log2fc_threshold,
        significant_log2fc_threshold
      ),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(
        adjusted_p_threshold
      ),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = volcano_labels,
      ggplot2::aes(
        label = gene
      ),
      size = 3.2,
      box.padding = 0.4,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Upregulated" = "#D73027",
        "Downregulated" = "#4575B4",
        "Not significant" = "grey70"
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Spatial Cluster ",
        cluster_id
      ),
      subtitle = "Cluster compared with all remaining spatial spots",
      x = "Average log2 fold change",
      y = expression(
        -log[10](
          "adjusted p-value"
        )
      ),
      color = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 14
      ),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 10,
        color = "grey35"
      ),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "left"
    )

  print(
    volcano_plot
  )

  volcano_file <- file.path(
    volcano_directory,
    paste0(
      "spatial_cluster_",
      cluster_id,
      "_volcano.png"
    )
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = volcano_file,
    plot = volcano_plot,
    width = 7,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 600
  )

  volcano_files <- c(
    volcano_files,
    volcano_file
  )

  volcano_plot_list[[cluster_id]] <- volcano_plot
}

cat(
  "Volcano plots generated: ",
  length(volcano_files),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 21. Generate combined spatial cluster volcano panel
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

combined_volcano_file <- NULL

if (length(volcano_plot_list) > 0) {

  combined_volcano_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    volcano_plot_list,
    ncol = 3
  )

  number_volcano_rows <- ceiling(
    length(volcano_plot_list) / 3
  )

  combined_volcano_file <- file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_cluster_volcano_panel.png"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = combined_volcano_file,
    plot = combined_volcano_plot,
    width = 20,
    height = max(
      6,
      number_volcano_rows * 6
    ),
    dpi = 600,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  if (!file.exists(combined_volcano_file)) {
    stop(
      "Combined spatial volcano panel was not saved successfully:\n",
      combined_volcano_file
    )
  }

  cat(
    "Combined spatial volcano panel saved successfully:\n",
    combined_volcano_file,
    "\n"
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 22. Examine Prkcd differential expression across spatial clusters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Examining Prkcd across spatial clusters\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

if (gene_of_interest %in% rownames(spatial_object)) {
  prkcd_marker_results <- cluster_markers %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      gene == gene_of_interest
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      p_val_adj
    )

  cat(
    "Prkcd differential-expression results:\n"
  )

  print(
    prkcd_marker_results
  )

  prkcd_marker_file <- file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_Prkcd_cluster_DEA.csv"
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    prkcd_marker_results,
    prkcd_marker_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
} else {
  warning(
    "Prkcd was not found in the spatial Seurat object."
  )

  prkcd_marker_file <- NULL
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 23. Generate Prkcd UMAP visualization
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

prkcd_umap_file <- NULL

if (gene_of_interest %in% rownames(spatial_object)) {
  prkcd_umap <- Seurat::FeaturePlot(
    object = spatial_object,
    features = gene_of_interest,
    reduction = "umap"
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Prkcd Expression Across Spatial UMAP"
    )

  print(
    prkcd_umap
  )

  prkcd_umap_file <- file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_Prkcd_UMAP.png"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = prkcd_umap_file,
    plot = prkcd_umap,
    width = 7,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 600
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 24. Generate Prkcd violin plot across spatial clusters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

prkcd_violin_file <- NULL

if (gene_of_interest %in% rownames(spatial_object)) {
  prkcd_violin <- Seurat::VlnPlot(
    object = spatial_object,
    features = gene_of_interest,
    group.by = cluster_column,
    pt.size = 0
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Prkcd Expression Across Spatial Clusters",
      x = "Spatial cluster",
      y = "Expression"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    )

  print(
    prkcd_violin
  )

  prkcd_violin_file <- file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_Prkcd_violin_by_cluster.png"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = prkcd_violin_file,
    plot = prkcd_violin,
    width = 9,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 600
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 25. Generate spatial Prkcd maps for each tissue section
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

prkcd_spatial_file <- NULL

if (gene_of_interest %in% rownames(spatial_object)) {
  prkcd_spatial_normal <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
    spatial_object,
    features = gene_of_interest,
    images = "Naive_A9"
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Normal tissue"
    )

  prkcd_spatial_niacin <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
    spatial_object,
    features = gene_of_interest,
    images = "Niacin2_B5"
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Niacin treatment"
    )

  prkcd_spatial_vehicle1 <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
    spatial_object,
    features = gene_of_interest,
    images = "Vehicle1_C5"
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Vehicle 1"
    )

  prkcd_spatial_vehicle2 <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
    spatial_object,
    features = gene_of_interest,
    images = "Vehicle2_D5"
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Vehicle 2"
    )

  prkcd_spatial_overview <- (
    prkcd_spatial_normal |
    prkcd_spatial_niacin |
    prkcd_spatial_vehicle1 |
    prkcd_spatial_vehicle2
  )

  print(
    prkcd_spatial_overview
  )

  prkcd_spatial_file <- file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_Prkcd_all_slides.png"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = prkcd_spatial_file,
    plot = prkcd_spatial_overview,
    width = 20,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 600
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 26. Validate differential-expression results
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Validating spatial differential-expression results\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

required_marker_columns <- c(
  "gene",
  "cluster",
  "avg_log2FC",
  "p_val",
  "p_val_adj",
  "significance"
)

missing_marker_columns <- setdiff(
  required_marker_columns,
  colnames(cluster_markers)
)

if (length(missing_marker_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required marker-result column(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_marker_columns,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

marker_clusters <- sort(
  unique(
    as.character(
      cluster_markers$cluster
    )
  )
)

missing_marker_clusters <- setdiff(
  cluster_ids,
  marker_clusters
)

if (length(missing_marker_clusters) > 0) {
  warning(
    "No marker results were returned for spatial cluster(s): ",
    paste(
      missing_marker_clusters,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(colnames(cluster_markers)) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicated column names detected in final marker table."
  )
}

cat(
  "Spatial differential-expression result validation completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 27. Validate expected Module 08 outputs
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_result_files <- c(
  dea_parameter_file,
  all_marker_file,
  significant_marker_file,
  positive_marker_file,
  negative_marker_file,
  marker_summary_file,
  top_marker_file,
  cluster_table_files
)

if (!is.null(prkcd_marker_file)) {
  expected_result_files <- c(
    expected_result_files,
    prkcd_marker_file
  )
}

expected_figure_files <- c(
  cluster_heatmap_file,
  volcano_files
)

if (exists("combined_volcano_file")) {
  expected_figure_files <- c(
    expected_figure_files,
    combined_volcano_file
  )
}

if (!is.null(prkcd_umap_file)) {
  expected_figure_files <- c(
    expected_figure_files,
    prkcd_umap_file
  )
}

if (!is.null(prkcd_violin_file)) {
  expected_figure_files <- c(
    expected_figure_files,
    prkcd_violin_file
  )
}

if (!is.null(prkcd_spatial_file)) {
  expected_figure_files <- c(
    expected_figure_files,
    prkcd_spatial_file
  )
}

missing_result_files <- expected_result_files[
  !file.exists(expected_result_files)
]

missing_figure_files <- expected_figure_files[
  !file.exists(expected_figure_files)
]

if (length(missing_result_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 08 result files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_result_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

if (length(missing_figure_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 08 figure files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_figure_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

cat(
  "All expected Module 08 output files were created successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 28. Final module summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 08 COMPLETE — Spatial cluster differential expression\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Spatial clusters:        ", length(cluster_ids), "\n",
  "Total marker results:    ", nrow(cluster_markers), "\n",
  "Significant DEGs:        ", nrow(significant_cluster_markers), "\n",
  "Upregulated DEGs:        ", nrow(significant_positive_markers), "\n",
  "Downregulated DEGs:      ", nrow(significant_negative_markers), "\n",
  "Testing log2FC cutoff:   ", marker_test_log2fc_threshold, "\n",
  "Reporting log2FC cutoff: ", significant_log2fc_threshold, "\n",
  "Adjusted P cutoff:       ", adjusted_p_threshold, "\n",
  "Volcano plots:           ", length(volcano_files), "\n",
  "\n",
  "Complete DEG table:\n",
  "  ", all_marker_file, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Significant DEG table:\n",
  "  ", significant_marker_file, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Cluster-specific tables:\n",
  "  ", cluster_table_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "DEA results:\n",
  "  ", results_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "DEA figures:\n",
  "  ", figure_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Next module:\n",
  "  09_spatial_infercnv.Rmd\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
